fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not specify the sheaf, clause-to-cell routing, cochain map, Construction-A basis, or target proving that a falsification is a non-boundary class. SNF of the K6 2-skeleton cannot test cosystolic expansion, routing preservation, or a polynomial family, so O6, O9, and O12 remain untouched.

Proposal 2 remains exponentially dimensional: M_F acts on 2^n assignment coordinates, and no linear polynomial-size representation enforces that a compressed tensor is a genuine assignment vector. Moreover, F is a sum of local diagonal terms and therefore already has polynomial operator-Schmidt rank, so measuring small-instance bond dimension does not discriminate the determinant, rank-one, pseudo-kernel, or asymptotic-size blockers O8, O11, and O12.

Proposal 3 has an exact signed zero-syndrome attack: 000 = 011 + 100 - 111 preserves selector normalization and every occurrence-bit projection while using only OR-satisfying labels. Any linear Reed–Solomon syndrome sees the honest global word 000, and unique decoding cannot canonicalize its signed local decomposition; thus O5–O6 survive independently of q, carries, or distance.

Proposal 4 permits formula-specific quadratic fitting without a uniform polynomial-time synthesis rule, bounded coefficient encoding, or common construction template. A finite separating ellipsoid would establish neither a reduction nor a dimension-dependent gap, while introducing quadratization ancillas returns to O5–O6; the proposed box search is therefore non-discriminating for O12.

Proposal 5 never supplies product-sensitive linear coordinates. Summing regular-representation transition rows does not encode ordered multiplication, while tracking cumulative products converts the construction into a layered trellis admitting the signed-flow obstruction O7; exterior-power coordinates additionally leave O11 pseudo-solutions unresolved.

Proposal 6 is not a bounded search because rational Gram entries have no denominator bound and the allowed quadratic interactions and coercivity conditions are unspecified. Excluding one affine valued polymorphism does not certify all signed overlap compositions, and even a perfect constant clause gadget gives only a constant additive penalty when one clause is false against an aggregate honest baseline, leaving O3 and O12 fatal.
evidence: Generation 7 supplies an unrestricted fixed-target counterexample: 011 + 100 - 111 produces zero raw and radix residual, with exact squared minimum 80 versus Boolean baseline 72. Linear coding or reweighting cannot detect that existing affine kernel.

Generation 5 found norm-at-most-4 integer overlap circuits in every one of 5,832 tested composed systems and 95,256 references, despite exact local isolation certificates. This directly refutes promotion of local or private-row isolation to composition.

Generation 1 shows amplified residuals can be annihilated by unrestricted integer slack, and Generation 6 shows external filters, changed references, and filtered SNF calculations are not CVP soundness evidence.

No proposal provides an explicit polynomial-size fixed-target family, unrestricted soundness argument, or approximation ratio growing as n^c. None of the proposed finite tests can resolve its proposal's stated fatal mechanism.
next_experiment: None for the current proposals. Reopen only with an explicit polynomial-size fixed-target mutation whose emitted coordinates provably make both 011+100-111 and the full cube-parity replacement nonzero under unrestricted overlaps; then run one exact box-free CVP audit on the nine-clause obstruction and a fixed satisfiable control with stated completeness and soundness thresholds.
